params.quorumSigners: the claimed addresses of the consenting members, sorted strictly ascending,                      parallel to quorumSigs (each validated via SignatureChecker — EOA or ERC-1271)

constructor.details: Locks the implementation contract so only proxies (via initialize) are usable.

establishHouse(string,address[],uint8[],.details: Members MUST be passed sorted by ascending address (canonical order → no duplicate member);      kinds/titles/signatures are parallel arrays. Requires ≥2 members, ≥1 Neuma (each proven via      Natalis) and ≥1 Witness. The recorded house is exactly the signed set.

params.kinds: each member's kind (Neuma|Witness), parallel to members
params.members: founding member addresses, sorted strictly ascending
params.name: the house name (case-insensitive for uniqueness; stored original-case)
params.signatures: each member's signature over foundingDigest(...), parallel to members
params.titles: each member's free-form title, parallel to members

params.natalis_: the deployed Natalis registry — the root of neuma identity (isNeuma)

leaveHouse(bytes32,address,bytes).details: `leaver` is the CLAIMED departing member; its `selfSig` over `leaveDigest` is validated via      SignatureChecker (EOA by ECDSA, smart account by ERC-1271) — matching how members sign      everywhere else, so a smart-account member can take refuge too. A non-member address reverts      `NotAMember`; a member address with a bad or non-matching signature reverts `MemberDidNotSign`.      Both fail closed — the leave doesn't happen.

params.leaver: the departing member (must currently be in the house)
params.selfSig: the leaver's signature over leaveDigest(houseId, currentNonce)

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

addMember(bytes32,address,uint8,string,b.notice: Add a member. The NEW member consents (consentSig) AND a majority of current members sign.

changeDigest(bytes32,uint8,bytes,uint64).notice: The digest a quorum signs to authorize a change. `params` is the abi.encode of the action's         arguments (the same encoding the contract builds internally), bound with the house nonce.

changeTitle(bytes32,address,string,addre.notice: Change a member's title by majority vote.

establishHouse(string,address[],uint8[],.notice: Establish a house — TOGETHER. Every founding member must sign `foundingDigest`.

foundingDigest(string,address[],uint8[],.notice: The digest every founding member signs.

getHouse(bytes32).notice: Public house fields (members read separately via getMembers).

getMembers(bytes32).notice: The current member addresses of a house.

houseIdOf(string).notice: The id a name maps to (case-insensitive). A house exists iff its status is not None.

housesEverJoined(address).notice: Every house `who` has ever been a member of — the permanent record of what they were         connected to (each house appears once, even across leaving and rejoining).

isMember(bytes32,address).notice: True if `member` is currently in the house.

leaveDigest(bytes32,uint64).notice: The digest a departing member signs to leave.

leaveHouse(bytes32,address,bytes).notice: Leave a house of your own accord (refuge — no vote required). Anyone may relay your signed         exit. Leaving may WOUND the house (drop it below the ≥1-Neuma + ≥1-Witness floor) and it         stays Active and recoverable; the house DISSOLVES only when your exit leaves it fully empty         (no members left). You are never trapped to keep a house alive.

memberInfo(bytes32,address).notice: A member's role in a house.

quorumOf(bytes32).notice: The number of member signatures a change currently needs (strict majority).

removeMember(bytes32,address,address[],b.notice: Remove a member by majority vote — no unilateral removals, even by the head. Cannot vote         the house below viability (≥2 members, ≥1 Neuma, ≥1 Witness); to fall below that, a member         must leave of their own accord (see leaveHouse).

wasEverMember(bytes32,address).notice: True if `who` was EVER a member of this house — permanent; survives leaving, removal, and         even the house's dissolution. (`isMember` is the CURRENT membership; this is the history.)
